name: costsentinel-reporting
description: Read-only FinOps reporting for multi-subscription Azure estates. Detects waste and spend anomalies, costs remediations from provider data, and reports what is awaiting a human decision. Every skill is read-only: this agent proposes and reports, and has no path to change a resource.

extensions.description: Every skill on this card only reads. A task can be cancelled before it runs; nothing on this surface can change a resource or record a decision.

skills.name: Request a cost review
skills.description: Run a read-only sweep of a client's estate and return the report: findings, ranked recommendations, projected savings, spend changes and what is awaiting a human decision. Reads only. Proposes; never applies.
examples: Produce a cost review for northwind-energy.
What waste is there in the ministry-of-transport estate?

skills.name: Fetch the current findings
skills.description: Return the findings from the most recent sweep for a client, without running a new one. Reads a stored result; touches no cloud.
examples: What did the last review of northwind-energy find?

skills.name: Fetch the pending-approval queue
skills.description: Return the gated actions awaiting a human decision, with the figures the report showed. Read-only: this surface can report what is waiting and cannot decide it. A decision is recorded by a person, and an approval hands the action to a person -- CostSentinel has no execution path.
examples: What is waiting on an approval for the ministry estate?
